text_1981: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
text_1989: In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful
text_ref: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

text_1981: We revealed it in the Night of Destiny.*
footnote_1981: *97:1 The Quran was placed into Muhammad's soul on the 27th night of Ramadan, 13 B.H. (Before Hijrah). See also 17:1, 44:3, 53:1-18, and Appendix 28.
text_1989: We revealed it in the Night of Destiny.*
text_ref: We revealed it in the Night of Destiny.*
footnote_ref: *97:1 The Quran was placed into Muhammad's soul on the 27th night of Ramadan, 13 B.H. (Before Hijrah). See also 17:1, 44:3, 53:1-18, and Appendix 28.

text_1981: How awesome is the Night of Destiny!
text_1989: How awesome is the Night of Destiny!
text_ref: How awesome is the Night of Destiny!

text_1981: The Night of Destiny is better than a thousand months.
text_1989: The Night of Destiny is better than a thousand months.
text_ref: The Night of Destiny is better than a thousand months.

text_1981: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by their Lord's leave, to carry out every command.
text_1989: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by their Lord’s leave, to carry out every command.
text_ref: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by their Lord's leave, to carry out every command.

text_1981: Peaceful it is until the advent of the dawn.
text_1989: Peaceful it is until the advent of the dawn
text_ref: Peaceful it is until the advent of the dawn.
